name: Lechonk
description: Lechonk, the Hog Pokémon. Able to evolve into Oinkologne Male . A Normal type.
pokedex_entries: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.
This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
